parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm at about 90-95 bpm with narrow QRS complexes and normal R-wave progression; there are no pathologic Q waves, and no two contiguous leads show ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria (V2-V3 show only slight J-point elevation, which is normal), so this does not support the suspected acute STEMI, though the limb leads are noisy with baseline wander.
